guestBioOfficial.en: In this special compilation episode, we delve into failure—an overlooked source of wisdom. From freezing onstage in front of thousands of people, to coworkers staging an intervention, to huge product investments that went to zero, we’ve pulled our favorite stories of failure from 100+ podcast episodes. I hope these stories serve as a gentle nudge to view failure not as a setback but as a crucial detour toward growth.
guestBioOfficial.zh: 在这期特别合集节目中，我们深入探讨失败——这一常被忽视的智慧之源。从在数千人面前舞台上僵住，到同事们展开劝退行动，再到巨额产品投资化为乌有，我们从100多期播客中精选了最喜欢的失败故事。希望这些故事能给人以启发，让人们不再将失败视为挫折，而是看作通向成长的关键转折。

chapters.title: Lenny: Why I’m focusing on failure
Katie Dill: The single meeting that changed how Katie leads forever
Paul Adams: Freezing onstage in front of thousands of people
Tom Conrad: Lessons from Pets.com and Quibi—two of the most famous product disasters of all time
Sri Batchu: When you fail, make sure you fail conclusively
Jiaona Zhang (JZ): One of the biggest product misses at Airbnb
Gina Gotthilf: Everyone has an “A side” and a “B side,” and we should all share our B sides more
Maggie Crowley: Her favorite interview question about failure, and lessons from a personal failure

summary.en: Instead of a standard interview, this episode curates the best failure stories from across the podcast's back catalog into one focused listen. Lenny makes the case that studying how things break—rather than only how the best companies operate—yields some of the most valuable lessons for builders. It's an experiment in thematic compilation, and Lenny invites listener feedback to decide whether to keep doing more like it.
summary.zh: 这期并非标准访谈，而是把播客过往节目中最精彩的失败故事精选编排成一期聚焦的节目。Lenny 提出一个观点：研究事物如何失败（而不只是研究最优秀的公司如何运作）能为建设者带来一些最有价值的经验。这是一次主题合集的尝试，Lenny 也邀请听众反馈，以决定是否继续做更多类似节目。
